messages.subject: Knitr version string
parts: How can I get Knitr's version string?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Knitr version string
parts:
packageVersion('knitr')

In fact you can use this function with any R packages to get the version string.

BTW, I use this versioning convention: x.x is the stable version (for
CRAN), and x.x.x is the development version (on GitHub). When I
introduce a relatively big feature, I will increment the third digit,
e.g. from 0.2.1 to 0.2.2 until the package is released as 0.3.
